build_seal_searcher: build a SEALSearcher instance from an FM index path and BART checkpoint for key-based retrieval
create_seal_document: create a SEALDocument object from an FM index, tokenized document, and delimiter IDs for title-body splitting
run_batch_search: run batch search on multiple queries using SEALSearcher to retrieve top-k documents by generated keys
test_batch_generate_keys: test batch_generate_keys to produce scored n-gram keys from input queries via constrained beam search
refactor_retrieve_from_keys: refactor retrieve_from_keys to aggregate evidence from n-gram keys and score documents using FM index frequencies
